verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Spline publishes an llms.txt at docs.spline.design that returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of its documentation. A second probe confirms docs pages are served as raw markdown (.md) variants, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and any first-party guidance on using llms.txt with agents (e.g., an llms-full.txt or an agent-usage page).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.spline.design/llms.txt # Spline Documentation
